meta.title: Same Mulank, alag saal — 2026 → 2027
meta.cta: send to someone who needs it + link to the complete 2027 guide
meta.text_rules: min 48 px, max 2 text items on screen, captions count

beats.line: Dono ka mulank ek… phir uska sab sahi kaise, mera nahi?!

caption_chunks.text: phir uska sab sahi kaise, mera nahi?!

beats.picture: Rooftop night. Monty's phone: friend's story (face not shown), new car, '2026 ✓'. Frame 0: jealous side-eye, smoke from his head. Hook text 'SAME MULANK, ALAG KISMAT?' from frame 0.
beats.camera: Starts on the phone, pulls back to Monty.

beats.picture: MEME (original Steven He audio), Monty lip-syncs: hand on heart, knees buckle, then full wail. Vishnu ji not on screen.

beats.line: Arre, mulank same hai… saal nahi.
beats.picture: Vishnu ji on his cloud: popcorn, eyebrow up, quick wink.

beats.line: Saal ka kya logic hai? Sab toh mulank-mulank karte rehte hain!

caption_chunks.text: Sab toh mulank-mulank karte rehte hain!

beats.picture: Sakshi pops in as assistant and switches on a BIG SCREEN on the rooftop wall: WOH · 12 APRIL and TUM · 3 MARCH, both MULANK 3.
beats.camera: Wide: screen, Vishnu ji, Sakshi, Monty.

beats.line: Personal year: date + month + saal… single digit tak jodo.
beats.picture: Big screen in large digits: 'DATE + MONTH + SAAL', then '2026 = 2+0+2+6 = 10 → 1'. Vishnu ji's chakra points like a teacher's pointer.

beats.line: Uska: 1, 2, 4, 1… 8. Tera: 3, 3, 1… 7. Haan beta, 7. Rona mana hai.
beats.picture: Big screen builds '12 APR → 1+2+4+1 = 8' (gold 8) and '3 MAR → 3+3+1 = 7'. Monty sulks at 8, lip trembles at 7; Vishnu ji teasing grin on 'rona mana hai'.

beats.line: Numerology mein 8 matlab result ka saal. 7 matlab ruk ke, khud pe kaam karne ka saal.

caption_chunks.text: Numerology mein 8 matlab result ka saal.
7 matlab ruk ke, khud pe kaam karne ka saal.

beats.picture: Label 'In numerology'. Screen: trophy on 8; lamp and book on 7. Sakshi gives Monty a sympathetic pout.

beats.line: Matlab wo party kare, main meditation?!

caption_chunks.text: Matlab wo party kare, main meditation?!

beats.picture: Monty cries under a tiny rain cloud.
Year flip: Vishnu ji flicks his chakra; the big screen's '2026' tears away like a calendar page, '2027' shows, fireworks. Monty looks up, hopeful.
Big screen recalculates: TUM → 3+3+2 = 8 (gold), WOH → 1+2+4+2 = 9. Monty cheers.

beats.line: Uska 9: purana samet ke, safai ka saal. Aur tera 8? Result… mehnat ka. Lottery nahi.

caption_chunks.text: purana samet ke, safai ka saal.

beats.picture: WOH profile packs old boxes, broom sweeps (calm). Bricks stack by Monty, a lottery ticket floats away. Label 'In numerology'.
MEME (original Puneet Superstar audio), Vishnu ji lip-syncs to Monty with a playful grin; Sakshi giggles by the screen.

beats.line: Mulank batata hai tum kaun ho… personal year, mausam kaisa hai.

caption_chunks.text: Mulank batata hai tum kaun ho…

beats.picture: Vishnu ji serene, slow push-in. Label 'In numerology'.

beats.line: Jiska mulank same par haal alag, usse bhejo. Poori 2027 guide ke liye, link pe click karo.

caption_chunks.text: Jiska mulank same par haal alag, usse bhejo.
Poori 2027 guide ke liye, link pe click karo.

beats.picture: Sakshi winks; send arrow, then link chip. No deity.
Monty taps send and grins; Vishnu ji munches popcorn. Card: 'Send to someone who needs it · Complete guide: link'. Loops to frame 0.
